northStar: Become the standard assurance rail agents call automatically before consequential actions and after important outputs.
promise: Before your agent acts, OCN checks evidence, authority, freshness and policy. After it acts, OCN leaves a verifiable receipt.

trustModel.principle: Verifiable assurance for specific claims in a specific context at a specific time; never a universal trust score.

currentSprint.name: Launch + Shadow Mode + Trust Proof Registry
nextCriticalMoves: Deploy exact green head to a stable public HTTPS endpoint.
Publish a Trust Proof Registry and example Trust Envelope for every live trusted event.
Run 1, then 10, then 20 repeated external x402 trusted-event settlements against the public endpoint.
Verify Bazaar/Agentic.Market discovery and publish MCP/JS developer installation paths.
Launch OCN Shadow Mode on one external agent workflow with no blocking authority.
Measure stale evidence, weak evidence, authority mismatches, review time, false-block/false-allow and p95 latency.
Convert one useful Shadow Mode finding into a paid EUR 5k-15k design-partner pilot or EUR 25k-50k institutional pilot.
Use the first buyer evidence to decide which capability to deepen next; do not expand the 160-capability backlog speculatively.
Begin targeted discovery with public IT providers, Agentic AI Hub participants and regulated enterprise agent teams.
Run hosted 100 RPS then 1k RPS tests only after the public deterministic trust event is stable.
